# Study I engine

Study I uses a single latent continuous input deterministically thresholded
into one ordinal factor. The module contains its posterior engine, prediction
targets, data-generating mechanism, baselines, and scoring rules.

```{r copy-study1-engine, include=FALSE}
repository_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
source_file <- file.path(
  repository_dir, "script", "R-scripts", "00_study1_functions.R"
)
target_file <- file.path(usethis::proj_get(), "R", basename(source_file))
stopifnot(file.copy(source_file, target_file, overwrite = TRUE))
stopifnot(identical(
  unname(tools::md5sum(source_file)), unname(tools::md5sum(target_file))
))
```
